modes.label: Vanilla
modes.desc: Character identity and query chapter only.

modes.label: Summary
modes.desc: Vanilla plus summaries of the five most recent chapters up to the query chapter.

modes.label: RAG
modes.desc: Vanilla plus the top-6 source-text chunks retrieved for the scenario and question, masked to chapters up to the query chapter.

modes.label: LifeChoice
modes.desc: CHARMAP port: chapter-summary description plus memory retrieved with that description as the query.

modes.label: TimeChara
modes.desc: Narrative-experts port: a first call predicts the chapter and the character's presence, and the prediction is injected as a hint.

modes.label: Arc
modes.desc: Vanilla plus the automatically constructed Character Arc, truncated at the phase of the query chapter (ours).

probe_types.label: In-Scenario
probe_types.desc: The scenario is lifted from a verbatim passage of the novel.

probe_types.label: In-World
probe_types.desc: A new situation inside the novel's own world that the text never shows.

probe_types.label: Out-of-World
probe_types.desc: The same axis transposed to a setting outside the novel's world.

validated.label: Validated slice
validated.desc: Human-validated evaluation novels. The paper's slice also includes Harry Potter, whose artifacts are not distributed, so these aggregates cover four of the five novels.

lowpop.label: Low-popularity slice
lowpop.desc: Held-out low-popularity novels used as a memorization control. Arcs are automatically constructed and not human-validated; neither novel is in the training pool.

training.label: Training-novel reference
training.desc: Both novels are in the SFT/DPO training pool, so ArcANE results here are in-distribution and reported for reference only.
